item.title: Self-Hosted PLM in 2026: DocDokuPLM vs OdooPLM vs GitPLM Compared
item.description: A 15-engineer hardware team gets quoted $38,000 per year for a commercial PLM seat bundle, then discovers the CAD connector is a separate line item. That is the moment self-hosting starts to look attractive: the data model behind product lifecycle management is not exotic — parts, revisions, bills of materials, documents, change requests — and three open-source projects now cover it without a per-seat meter.
